_about: Acetonitrile (1) + n-Hexane (2): isothermal total pressures at 348.2 K. Rows: temperature in K, liquid mole fraction of acetonitrile, pressure in kPa, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record. Rows with x_1 = 0 and 1 are the pure-component pressures measured with the same set.

source.citation: C. Narasigadu, P. Naidoo, C. Coquelet, D. Richon, D. Ramjugernath, A novel static analytical apparatus for phase equilibrium measurements, Fluid Phase Equilib. 338 (2013) 188-196
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 14, 15. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).

two_liquids.notes: The two liquids in equilibrium, as stored in the records (mole fraction of component 1 in each; record: the index in records). P is the three-phase or the stated pressure where the record gives one. Fitted as liquid-liquid equilibrium (fit_parameters.py); rows of the curve strictly between the two liquids at the same temperature are not fitted as one liquid. To be checked by a person against the records (AGENTS.md rule 4).
